event.value: Gate alarm on the floodways; the Ferrymaster's first read was a confused fare. He offered the crossing out, explained the water, asked him to leave his weapon on the dock — the way out was running and the ride was free.

First fight: his surf walls washed the intruder safely back toward the entrance nine times; the protagonist read rescue as attack and fought his way inland against the current. The strangest crossing the Ferrymaster has ever worked.

Continuance return: he remembers every refused crossing. 'I have washed you to the door nine times. The tenth ride is also free.' The ferryfolk carry the young and the stores up-causeway when the amulet glows.

notes: Modeled at rematch stage (rung 4). Calibration call: the Ferrymaster pities more than he hates — affection 15 is a ferryman's professional compassion for the one passenger who will not board, will not leave, and will not drown. Fear 35 is moderate and specific: his horror is a drowning on his route, and he will not cause one even in defense, so the man is a problem he cannot solve with his tools. Trust deeply negative post-realization ('You understand every word I say, don't you?'). Deltas sum to current dimensions.
